newsitem.title: USA: NYSEG says validated by regulatory ruling.
newsitem.headline: NYSEG says validated by regulatory ruling.

text.p: New York State Electric & Gas Corp said late Wednesday it believes it has been validated by a New York State Public Service Commission ruling concerning CalEnergy Co Inc's tender offer for 9.9 percent of the utility.
Although regulators said CalEnergy could proceed with its offer, NYSEG said it was pleased that the commission said it has not prejudged whether a takeover of NYSEG would be endorsed.
In addition, the commission also ordered CalEnergy to file for approval of any additional share purchases by no later than August 29.
The panel also has required CalEnergy to refrain from interfering in NYSEG's restructuring plan.

"The PSC's order validates what we have said all along," spokeswoman Katherine Karlson said in a news release. "CalEnergy must now abide by a formal process which will give careful and deliberate consideration to CalEnergy's fitness and qualifications to be entrusted with the management of a complex electric and natural gas distribution system in New York."
CalEnergy has launched the $159 million tender offer as the first step in a plan to buy the whole utility in a transaction valued at $1.9 billion.
